global_invariants: Every workflow authorizes before query/projection and reauthorizes immediately before authoritative mutation or target traversal.

Reusable Item Definition, Asset Instance, ownership/custody/possession/control/access, containment, equipment assignment, mutable state, knowledge state, and transaction history remain distinct layers.

Reference inspection, compare, filtering, preview, recommendation, provisional selection, shopping cart composition, and trade drafting are non-authoritative until the owning workflow accepts an explicit command.
Source Definitions are never rewritten by Campaign ownership, equipment, charges, durability, identification, prices, containers, trade, crafting, Scene loot, or runtime use.
Hidden Asset existence, child counts, quantities, values, weights, occupancy, loot, reservations, history, provenance, and diagnostics are removed before unauthorized serialization or aggregation.
Source fact, source-unspecified value, reference-only name, conflict, inference, and owner-delegated recommendation status remain distinguishable.
Unknown is not zero; source-unspecified capacity is not unlimited; unidentified is not absent; equipped is not owned; custody is not ownership.
Accepted mutations are idempotent, expected-version checked, and lineage-preserving; ambiguous network outcomes use command-status lookup before retry.
Every drag/drop or spatial inventory action has keyboard, touch, and screen-reader-equivalent commands.
AI and service actors receive minimum operation-specific projections and cannot independently transfer, consume, create, destroy, reveal, or promote Assets.

workflows.name: Library / Item Inspector reference flow
steps: search or resolve exact stable ID
open role-safe Definition or authorized Asset Instance projection
inspect source mechanics and provenance state
optionally compare exact permitted versions or conflicts
optionally hand provisional stable-ID selection to an owning workflow
privacy_requirements: hidden Assets and hidden container children contribute no search suggestions, counts, facets, aggregates, compare candidates, relationship counts, or provenance hints
recovery_requirements: deep links and cached navigation reauthorize before delivery

workflows.name: Character inventory acquisition, movement, and containment flow
preconditions: resolve exact Asset Instance and current authority relations
steps: validate capacity, nesting, restrictions, and hidden-information projection
persist event and refresh role-safe inventory
privacy_requirements: hidden children are excluded before child counts, total weight/value, occupancy, previews, search, exports, and AI context
recovery_requirements: same operation ID for retry; stale expected version returns current authorized state without auto-overwrite
accessibility_requirements: Move to… and Remove from… commands replace drag-only behavior

workflows.name: Equipment, loadout, installation, and attunement flow
steps: show slot/host effects and requirement warnings
privacy_requirements: only authorized installed modules, bonded items, and hidden properties contribute to projection or counts
recovery_requirements: reconnect restores authoritative assignment; client cache cannot re-equip or revert state

workflows.name: Quantity, stack, split, and merge flow
preconditions: resolve exact quantities and expected versions
steps: reject incompatible merge with explicit reasons
persist child/merged lot lineage and refresh projections
forbidden_mutations: merge different ownership interests without explicit policy
privacy_requirements: unauthorized lots do not contribute merge candidates, counts, quantities, or aggregate totals
recovery_requirements: accepted split/merge cannot duplicate on retry; stale lot versions require refresh

workflows.name: Party/shared Asset lending, transfer, and return flow
preconditions: state exactly which relations will change
check recipient eligibility and expected versions
steps: persist transfer receipt and refresh both authorized projections
privacy_requirements: private offers, hidden holdings, and unrelated party Assets do not leak to nonparties
recovery_requirements: command-status lookup before retry after ambiguous response
receipt remains attributable to operation ID

workflows.name: GM Scene loot, reward, hidden Asset, and identification flow
preconditions: set existence/reveal/identification policy before Player projection
steps: place or prepare exact Asset/lot/reward bundle
set visible appearance or partial knowledge where permitted
set ownership/custody outcome only when granted
on discovery or identification submit governed reveal event
forbidden_mutations: client-side unhide of pre-delivered secret truth
privacy_requirements: before reveal, hidden Asset contributes no existence, count, value, weight, source, relationship, or diagnostic clue
recovery_requirements: reconnect recomputes knowledge from authoritative reveal history; stale cache cannot restore hidden truth
accessibility_requirements: keyboard reveal/identify controls for authorized GM

workflows.name: Shop, purchase, trade, and acquisition flow
preconditions: resolve price/currency source and transaction parties
steps: browse permitted offer without hidden stock leakage
compose non-authoritative cart or trade proposal
atomically update Asset/currency authority and persist receipt
privacy_requirements: hidden stock, GM-only prices, private offers, and another actor's holdings do not contribute counts or suggestions
recovery_requirements: ambiguous outcome uses operation-status lookup; purchase cannot duplicate

workflows.name: Combat use, ammunition, charges, reload, and consumption flow
preconditions: authorize controller and exact Asset Instance
steps: inspect exact cost and known capacity state
block or route source-unspecified maximum when required by the mechanic
on accepted event atomically apply use and resource cost
workflows.mutation_owner: authoritative Session/Action plus Asset resource workflow
forbidden_mutations: consume on denied or failed-before-commit action
client predicts accepted resource spend as truth
privacy_requirements: secret charges, hidden equipment, and GM-only resource states remain excluded from unauthorized projections
recovery_requirements: accepted event and Asset resource mutation share durable operation/event identity so reconnect cannot double-spend

workflows.name: Condition, durability, maintenance, and repair flow
preconditions: resolve current condition and expected version
steps: inspect current condition/durability and source/profile provenance
apply damage only through owning event/workflow
if disabled/broken follow bound profile instead of universal deletion
privacy_requirements: hidden damage or GM-only condition remains excluded according to current projection policy
recovery_requirements: stale repair work order refreshes current condition and reservations before commit

workflows.name: Crafting, modification, salvage, and material reservation flow
primary_personas: Creator where authoring is separately allowed
preconditions: authorize work order and exact input lots/Assets
resolve recipe/project Definition or explicit Campaign rule
steps: show required quantities/tools/time/checks without fabricating absent mechanics
on successful owning outcome atomically consume/transform inputs and create outputs/byproducts
record lineage from inputs to outputs
forbidden_mutations: create output on failed/cancelled work order
privacy_requirements: private projects and hidden inputs/outputs remain outside unrelated projections
recovery_requirements: reservation state and accepted completion are recovered by operation/work-order identity

workflows.name: Special Asset flow for living items, symbiotes, software, and modular equipment
preconditions: resolve exact presentation profile and capability model
steps: inspect specialized capability and source/provenance state
route host-biology consequences to PPIA-05 contracts where applicable
route vehicle installation to PPIA-04 where applicable
outputs: handoff to Character/host/vehicle domain where required
workflows.mutation_owner: profile-specific Asset workflow plus owning host domain
workflows.authoritative_mutation_performed: only for explicitly supported relation/state changes
forbidden_mutations: force software into physical weight/container semantics
host biology rewritten by generic inventory mutation
privacy_requirements: hidden traits, licenses, installed modules, bond conflicts, and host effects are projected only to authorized roles
recovery_requirements: cross-domain relation IDs and current authority are revalidated on resume

workflows.name: Conflict, provenance, history, export, and reconnect flow
preconditions: resolve current command/operation status on ambiguous mutation
steps: show source facts, recommendations, conflicts, source-unspecified fields, and reference-only state distinctly
never auto-merge same-name Taser contexts or reference-only names
on ambiguous mutation query operation status before retry
on reconnect discard unauthorized cached fields and load current role-safe state
workflows.mutation_owner: none for compare/export; original owning workflow for any retry
forbidden_mutations: restore revoked hidden data from cache
retry with new operation ID before status resolution
privacy_requirements: history and provenance are filtered before counts/aggregation/export; forbidden exact IDs do not reveal existence
recovery_requirements: current authorization, entitlement, pack/version, and operation status control restore

handoff_contracts.rule: Selection is provisional; destination reauthorizes and validates before mutation.
Reveal and acquisition/ownership are separate events unless a governed workflow explicitly combines them atomically.
Inventory reflects only accepted transaction output, never cart/proposal state.
Equipment assignment does not inherit ownership mutation authority.
Combat/action service revalidates controller, target, cost, and current Asset state before acceptance.
Downstream workflows revalidate lot state and reservations; stale split/merge assumptions cannot commit.
Equipment/use availability is recomputed from current condition; repair does not rewrite Definition mechanics.
Only committed work-order outputs enter inventory/equipment flows.
PPIA-03 does not invent vehicle or biological semantics; owning domain validates and commits them.
Ambiguous operations resume/retry through the original mutation owner with the same idempotency identity.

campaign_local_asset_authoring_allowed: current charges/ammunition where governing rules establish state
not_allowed_here: turn reference-only names into complete weapons
authoring_boundaries.source_recommendation_rule: Owner-delegated completion may be proposed/used only with explicit recommendation provenance; it is never relabeled as recovered source text.

completion_invariants: All 12 workflows preserve definition-versus-instance and authority-relation distinctions.
All authoritative mutations identify a single owning workflow/service and require revalidation before commit.
All mutation workflows specify recovery/idempotency behavior.
Hidden container/loot/transaction state is removed before unauthorized counts or aggregates.
Taser conflict, seven source-unspecified capacities, and three reference-only names remain unresolved/provenance-safe where appropriate.
Cross-domain vehicle/biology/balance semantics are routed, not invented.
Every workflow has an accessible non-drag/nonvisual path.
